ja533:1.1: Sumukha anupacinantā pakkamanti vihaṅgamā, gaccha tuvam pi, mā kaṃkhi, n' atthi baddhe sahāyatā ti.
ja533:2.1: Gacch' evāhaṃ na vā gacche na tena amaro siyaṃ, sukhitaṃ taṃ upāsitvā dukkhitaṃ taṃ kathaṃ jahe.
ja533:3.1: Maraṇaṃ vā tayā saddhiṃ jīvitaṃ vā tayā vinā tath' eva maraṇaṃ seyyo yañce jīve tayā vinā.
ja533:4.1: N' esa dhammo mahārāja yaṃ taṃ evaṃgataṃ jahe, yā gati tuyhaṃ sā mayhaṃ ruccate vihaṅgādhipa.
ja533:5.1: Kā nu pāsena baddhassa gati aññā mahānasā, sā kathaṃ cetayānassa muttassa tava ruccati.
ja533:6.1: Kaṃ vā tvaṃ passase atthaṃ mama tuyhañ ca pakkhima ñātīnaṃ vāvasiṭṭhānaṃ ubhinnaṃ jīvitakkhaye.
ja533:7.1: Yan na kañcanadepiccha andhena tamasā gataṃ tādise sañcajaṃ pāṇaṃ kam attham abhijotaye.
ja533:8.1: Kathan nu patataṃ seṭṭha dhamme atthaṃ na bujjhasi, dhammo apacito santo atthaṃ dasseti pāṇinaṃ.
ja533:9.1: So 'haṃ dhammaṃ apekkhāno dhammā c' atthaṃ samuṭṭhitaṃ bhattiñ ca tayi sampassaṃ nāvakaṃkhāmi jīvitaṃ.
ja533:10.1: Addhā eso sataṃ dhammo yo mitto mittam āpade na-ccaje jīvitassāpi hetu dhammam anussaraṃ.
ja533:11.1: Sv-āyaṃ dhammo ca te ciṇṇo bhattī ca viditā mayi, kāmaṃ karassu mayh' etaṃ, gacch' evānumato mayā.
ja533:12.1: Api tv-evaṃ gate kāle yaṃ bandhaṃ ñātinaṃ mayā tayā taṃ buddhisampannam assa paramasaṃvutaṃ.
ja533:13.1: Icc-eva mantayantānaṃ ariyānaṃ ariyavuttinaṃ paccadissatha nesādo āturānaṃ iv' antako.
ja533:14.1: Te sattum abhisamikkha dīgharattaṃ hitā dijā tuṇhīm āsittha ubhayo na ca sañcesum āsanā.
ja533:15.1: Dhataraṭṭhe ca disvāna samuḍḍente tato tato abhikkamatha vegena dijasattu dijādhipe.
ja533:16.1: So ca vegen' abhikkamma āsajja parame dije paccakampittha nesādo baddhā iti vicintayaṃ
ja533:17.1: Ekañ ca baddhaṃ āsīnaṃ abaddhañ ca punāparaṃ āsajja baddham āsīnaṃ pekkhamānam adīnavaṃ.
ja533:18.1: Tato so vimato yeva paṇḍare ajjhabhāsatha pavaddhakāye āsīne dijasaṃghagaṇādhipe:
ja533:19.1: Yan nu pāsena mahatā baddho na kurute desaṃ -- atha kasmā abaddho tvaṃ balī pakkhī na gacchasi.
ja533:20.1: Kin nu t'āyaṃ dijo hoti, mutto baddham upāsasi, (IV 426|10) ohāya sakuṇā yanti, kiṃ eko avahīyasi.
ja533:21.1: Rājā me so dijāmitta sakhā pāṇasamo ca me, n' eva naṃ vijahissāmi yāva kālassa pariyāyaṃ.
ja533:22.1: Kathaṃ panāyaṃ vihago nāddasa pāsam oḍḍitaṃ, padaṃ h' etaṃ mahantānaṃ, bodhum arahanti āpadaṃ.
ja533:23.1: Yadā parābhavo hoti poso jīvitasaṃkhaye (IV 425|27) atha jālañ ca pāsañ ca āsajjāpi na bujjhati.
ja533:24.1: Api tv-eva mahāpuñña pāsā bahuvidhā tatā gūḷham āsajja bajjhanti ath' evaṃ jīvitakkhaye ti.
ja533:25.1: Api n' āyaṃ tayā saddhiṃ sambhāsassa sukhudrayo, api no anumaññasi, api no jīvitaṃ dade ti g. ā.
ja533:26.1: Na c' eva me tvaṃ baddho si, na pi icchāmi te vadhaṃ, kāmaṃ khippam ito gantvā jīva tvaṃ anigho ciran ti g. ā.
ja533:27.1: N' evāham etaṃ icchāmi aññatr' etassa jīvitā, sace ekena tuṭṭho si muñc' etaṃ mañ ca bhakkhaya.
ja533:28.1: Ārohapariṇāhena tuly' asmā vayasā ubho, na te lābhena jīn' atthi, etena niminā tuvaṃ.
ja533:29.1: Tad iṃgha samavekkhassu, hotu giddhi tavāsmasu, maṃ pubbe bandha pāsena pacchā muñca dijādhipaṃ.
ja533:30.1: Tāvad eva ca te lābho katassā yācanāya ca mettī ca dhataraṭṭhehi yāvajīvāya te siyā ti.
ja533:31.1: Passantu no mahāsaṃghā tayā muttam ito gataṃ mittāmaccā ca bhaccā ca puttadārā ca bandhavā.
ja533:32.1: Na ca te tādisā mittā bahunnaṃ idha vijjati yathā tvaṃ dhataraṭṭhassa pāṇasādhāraṇo sakhā.
ja533:33.1: So te sahāyaṃ muñcāmi, hotu rājā tavānugo, kāmaṃ khippam ito gantvā ñātimajjhe virocathā 'ti.
ja533:34.1: So patīto pamuttena bhattunā bhattugāravo ajjhabhāsatha vakkaṅgo vācaṃ kaṇṇasukhaṃ bhaṇaṃ:
ja533:35.1: Evaṃ luddaka nandassu saha sabbehi ñātibhi yathāham ajja nandāmi muttaṃ disvā dijādhipan ti.
ja533:36.1: Ehi taṃ anusikkhāmi yathā tvam api lacchase lābhaṃ yathāyaṃ dhataraṭṭho pāpaṃ kiñci na dakkhati.
ja533:37.1: Khippam antepuraṃ netvā rañño dassehi no ubho abaddhe pakatibhūte kāce ubhayato ṭhite
ja533:38.1: Dhataraṭṭhā mahārāja haṃsādhipatino ime, ayaṃ hi rājā haṃsānaṃ, ayaṃ senāpatītaro.
ja533:39.1: Asaṃsayaṃ imaṃ disvā haṃsarājaṃ narādhipo patīto sumano vitto bahuṃ dassati te dhanan
ja533:40.1: ti. Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā kammanā upapādayi, khippam antepuraṃ gantvā rañño haṃse adassayi abaddhe pakatibhūte kāce ubhayato ṭhite.
ja533:41.1: Dhataraṭṭhā mahārāja haṃsādhipatino ime, ayaṃ hi rājā haṃsānaṃ, ayaṃ senāpatītaro
ja533:42.1: Kathaṃ pan' ime vihagā tava hatthattham āgatā, kathaṃ luddo mahantānaṃ issare-m-idha-m-ajjhagā.
ja533:43.1: Vihitā sant' ime pāsā pallalesu janādhipa yaṃ yadā yatanaṃ maññe dijānaṃ pāṇarodhanaṃ.
ja533:44.1: Tādisaṃ pāsam āsajja haṃsarājā abajjhatha, taṃ abaddho upāsīno mamāyaṃ ajjhabhāsatha:
ja533:45.1: Sudukkaraṃ anariyehi dahate bhāvam uttamaṃ bhattur atthe parakkanto dhamme yutto vihaṅgamo.
ja533:46.1: Attan' āyaṃ cajitvāna jīvitaṃ jīvitāraho anutthunanto āsīno bhattu yācittha jīvitaṃ.
ja533:47.1: Tassa taṃ. vacanaṃ sutvā pasādam aham ajjhagaṃ. tato taṃ pāmuñciṃ pāsā anuññāsiṃ sukhena ca.
ja533:48.1: So patīto pamuttena bhattunā bhattugāravo ajjhabhāsatha vakkaṅgo vācaṃ kaṇṇasukkhaṃ bhaṇaṃ.
ja533:49.1: Evaṃ luddaka nandassu saha sabbehi ñātibhi yathāham ajja nandāmi muttaṃ disvā dijādhipaṃ.
ja533:50.1: Ehi taṃ anusikkhāmi yathā tvam api lacchase lābhaṃ yathāyaṃ dhataraṭṭho pāpaṃ kiñci na dakkhati.
ja533:51.1: Khippam antepuraṃ gantvā rañño dassehi no ubho abaddhe pakatibhūte kāce ubhayato ṭhite.
ja533:52.1: Dhataraṭṭhā mahārāja haṃsādhipatino ime, ayaṃ hi rājā {haṃsānaṃ}, ayaṃ senāpatītaro.
ja533:53.1: Asaṃsayaṃ imaṃ disvā haṃsarājaṃ narādhipo patīto sumano vitto bahuṃ dassati te dhanaṃ.
ja533:54.1: Evam etassa vacanā ānītā 'me ubho mayā, etth' eva hi ime assu ubho anumatā mayā.
ja533:55.1: So 'yaṃ evaṃgato pakkhī dijo paramadhammiko. mādisassa hi luddassa janayeyyātha maddavaṃ.
ja533:56.1: Upāyanaṃ hi te deva nāññaṃ passāmi edisaṃ sabbasākuṇikagāme, taṃ passa manujādhipā 'ti.
ja533:57.1: Disvā nisinnaṃ rājānaṃ pīṭhe sovaṇṇaye subhe ajjhabhāsatha vakkaṅgo vācaṃ kaṇṇasukhaṃ bhaṇaṃ:
ja533:58.1: Kacci nu bhoto kusalaṃ, kacci bhoto anāmayaṃ, kacci raṭṭham idaṃ phītaṃ dhammena-m-anusissati.
ja533:59.1: Kusalañ c' eva me haṃsa, atho haṃsa anāmayaṃ, atho raṭṭham idaṃ phītaṃ dhammena-m-anusissati. Kacci
ja533:60.1: bhoto amaccesu doso koci na vijjati, kaccin nu te tav' atthesu nāvakaṃkhanti jīvitaṃ.
ja533:61.1: Atho pi me amaccesu doso koci na vijjati, atho p' ime mam' atthesu nāvakaṃkhanti jīvitaṃ.
ja533:62.1: Kacci te sādisī bhariyā assavā piyabhāṇinī puttarūpayasūpetā tava-cchandavasānugā.
ja533:63.1: Atho pi me sādisī bhariyā assavā piyabhāṇinī puttarūpayasūpetā mama-cchandavasānugā ti.
ja533:64.1: Bhavan tu kacci nu mahāsattuhatthatthataṃ gato dukkham āpajji vipulaṃ tasmiṃ paṭhamamāpade.
ja533:65.1: Kacci yan n' āpatitvāna daṇḍena samapothayi, evam etesaṃ jammānaṃ pākatikaṃ bhavati tāvade.
ja533:66.1: Khemam āsi mahārāja evam āpadi saṃsati na cāyaṃ kiñci-r-asmāsu sattū va samapajjatha.
ja533:67.1: Paccakampittha nesādo, pubbe va ajjhabhāsatha, tadāyaṃ Sumukho yeva paṇḍito paccabhāsatha.
ja533:68.1: Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā pasādam ayam ajjhagā, tato maṃ pāmuñci pāsā anuññāsi sukhena ca.
ja533:69.1: Idam pi Sumukhen' eva etadatthāya cintitaṃ bhoto sakāse āgamanaṃ etassa dhanaṃ icchatā
ja533:70.1: Svāgatañ c' ev' idaṃ bhavataṃ patīto c' asmi dassanā, eso api bahuṃ vittaṃ labhataṃ yāvat' icchīti.
ja533:71.1: Santappayitvā nesādaṃ bhogehi manujādhipo ajjhabhāsatha vakkaṅgaṃ vācaṃ kaṇṇasukhaṃ bhaṇan ti g. ā.
ja533:72.1: Yaṃ khalu dhammam ādhīnaṃ vaso vattati kiñcanaṃ sabb' atth' issariyaṃ bhavataṃ pasāsatha yad icchatha.
ja533:73.1: Dānatthaṃ upabhotthuṃ vā yaṃ c' aññaṃ upakappati etaṃ dadāmi vo vittaṃ issaraṃ issajāmi vo ti āha.
ja533:74.1: Yathā ca my-āyaṃ Sumukho ajjhabhāseyya paṇḍito kāmasā buddhisampanno tam my-āssa paramappiyan ti.
ja533:75.1: Ahaṃ khalu mahārāja nāgarājā-r-iv' antaraṃ pativattuṃ na sakkomi, na me so vinayo siyā.
ja533:76.1: Amhākam eva yo seṭṭho tvañ ca uttamasattavo bhūmipālo manussindo pūjā bahūhi hetubhi.
ja533:77.1: Tesaṃ ubhinnaṃ bhaṇataṃ vattamāne vinicchaye nāntaraṃ pativattabbaṃ pessena manujādhipā 'ti.
ja533:78.1: Dhammena kira nesādo: paṇḍito aṇḍajo iti, na h' eva akatattassa nayo etādiso siyā ti.
ja533:79.1: Evaṃ aggapakatimā evaṃ uttamasattavo yāvat' atthi mayā diṭṭhā nāññaṃ passāmi edisaṃ
ja533:80.1: Tuṭṭho 'smi vo pakatiyā vākyena madhurena ca, eso cāpi mama chando: ciraṃ passeyya vo ubho ti.
ja533:81.1: Yaṃ kiñci parame mitte katar asmāsu taṃ tayā, pattā nissaṃsayaṃ ty-āmhā bhattir asmāsu yā tava.
ja533:82.1: Aduñ ca nūna sumahā ñātisaṃghassa-m-antaraṃ, adassanena amhākaṃ dukkhaṃ bahūsu pakkhisu.
ja533:83.1: Tesaṃ sokavighātāya tayā anumatā mayaṃ taṃ padakkhiṇato katvā ñātī passem' arindama.
ja533:84.1: Addhāhaṃ vipulaṃ pītiṃ bhavataṃ vindāmi dassanā, eso cāpi mahā attho ñātivissāsanā siyā
ja533:85.1: ti. Idaṃ vatvā dhataraṭṭho haṃsarājā narādhipaṃ uttamajavamattāya ñātisaṃgham upāgamuṃ.
ja533:86.1: Te aroge anuppatte disvāna parame dije kekā ti-m-akaruṃ haṃsā, puthusaddo ajāyatha.
ja533:87.1: Te patītā pamuttena bhattunā bhattugāravā samantā parikariṃsu aṇḍajā laddhapaccayā ti.
ja533:88.1: Evam mittavataṃ atthā sabbe honti padakkhiṇā haṃsā yathā dhataraṭṭhā ñātisaṃgham upāgamun ti.
